verdict.rationale: gstack skills are plain SKILL.md files in a public GitHub repo, and the install is git-clone-and-copy. Dev mode symlinks the checkout into `.claude/skills/`, and skills are read from disk. That implies a lead could inspect the repo before installing and read the installed files afterward, but this is only implied by the distribution model, not documented as a review feature. Missing for 10: a documented pre-install listing of the files and scripts a skill adds, an explicit inventory of the installed files and scripts, and hands-on corroboration of the review workflow.
